answer: A scripted farm therefore has to pad 240 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is recorded against the sonnet challenge, the zephyr audit can replay the fable history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 4416 identities would post 3054 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
